W.note: Disciplined cyan halo and light sweep on a solid indigo button with strong focus ring, active state and reduced-motion handling, but the effect is subtle rather than truly ethereal.

X.note: Pastel iridescent pill with a blurred spinning bloom, long exhale easings and drifting arrow feels genuinely dreamlike, though the pale rest state has a soft affordance and the bloom is the heaviest to render.

Y.note: Saturated gradient button with an overshoot lift, light-band sweep and halo reads clearly at rest and gets ethereal on hover, with good focus and reduced-motion support.

Z.note: Glass button with a halo and sheen looks nice in motion but the translucent rest state with a small label has weak contrast and affordance on the dark blurred backdrop.
